Players Committee card image of [[Hunting Party (V) (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “During your control phase, if your bounty hunter or Trandoshan is escorting a non-frozen captive at a battleground site you control, opponent loses 1 Force. OR If your bounty hunter or Trandoshan just captured a character, opponent loses 1 Force. (Immune to Sense.)”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Dark/large/huntingparty.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26 e8445f0] (1 June 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is the latest version of that file.
